---
title: "Feature matrix PCA/UMAP sanity checks (§4.13g)"
output: html_document
---

```{r, setup}
# §4.13g — quantitative sanity gate on the full feature matrix: does cell-type
# identity (ontology) dominate, as expected (fingerprint confound); does
# protocol or imputation status dominate any PC (would indicate a technical
# artefact rather than biology).
#
# Reuses the same standardized-PCA/UMAP machinery as 05z-visualize-features.Rmd
# (05zz-feature-preprocessing.R's preprocess_feature_matrix(mode="embedding"))
# but is a pass/fail sanity notebook (04-2-chip-signal-sanity.Rmd convention:
# append_sanity(), qc/sanity_summary.csv, WARN not stopifnot), not an
# exploratory plot gallery -- 05z already covers the gallery use case.
#
# All checks run per (Event Type, transcript_filter) stratum, not pooled and
# not further split by Variability (unlike 05z) -- matches the stratification
# level 04-2/05b use and what 09-1-ml-local.R models at.
library(cluster)
library(uwot)
library(rsvd)
library(patchwork)
set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))

dir.create("qc/distributions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sanity_csv <- "qc/sanity_summary.csv"
append_sanity <- function(check_name, status, value, threshold, notes = "") {
  fwrite(
    data.table(
      check_name = check_name,
      status = status,
      value = value,
      threshold = threshold,
      notes = notes
    ),
    sanity_csv,
    append = TRUE
  )
}

source("05zz-feature-preprocessing.R")
aggregated_dt <- fread("processed_data/aggregated_dt_filtered.csv.gz")

meta_cols <- c(
  "ID", "IHEC", "uuid", "transcript_filter", "PSI",
  "Event Type", "gene_id", "seqnames", "Variability",
  "ontology", "project", "protocol"
)
feature_cols <- setdiff(names(aggregated_dt), meta_cols)

# §4.13l's per-mark H3K*_source columns (observed/imputed) may not exist yet
# if aggregated_dt_filtered.csv.gz predates that change -- degrade gracefully
# rather than error, and record that item 4 was skipped.
source_cols <- grep("_source$", names(aggregated_dt), value = TRUE)
has_imputed_info <- length(source_cols) > 0
if (!has_imputed_info) {
  message(
    "No *_source columns found in aggregated_dt -- imputation-dominance ",
    "check (item 4) will be skipped. Re-run 05-create-aggregated-dt.Rmd ",
    "(§4.13l) and rebuild aggregated_dt_filtered.csv.gz to enable it."
  )
}

strata <- unique(aggregated_dt[, .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)])
setorder(strata, `Event Type`, transcript_filter)

N_PCS             <- 30
DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET <- 100000L
SIL_SAMPLE_N      <- 3000L # silhouette is O(n^2) in memory/time; subsample further
UMAP_NEIGHBORS    <- 30
UMAP_MIN_DIST     <- 0.05
UMAP_METRIC       <- "cosine"
```


```{r, per-stratum-pca-checks, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
run_stratum <- function(this_et, this_tf) {
  stratum_key <- paste(this_et, this_tf, sep = "_")
  sub_dt <- aggregated_dt[`Event Type` == this_et & transcript_filter == this_tf]

  if (nrow(sub_dt) > DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET) {
    set.seed(getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L))
    sub_dt <- sub_dt[sample(.N, DOWNSAMPLE_TARGET)]
  }

  preprocessed <- preprocess_feature_matrix(
    feat_mat = as.matrix(sub_dt[, ..feature_cols]),
    histone_marks = histone_marks,
    mode = "embedding",
    drop_sparse = FALSE
  )
  feat_mat <- preprocessed$feat_mat
  if (ncol(feat_mat) < 2) {
    message(stratum_key, ": < 2 usable feature columns, skipping")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # --- PCA (randomized SVD on standardized features) ------------------------
  k <- min(N_PCS, nrow(feat_mat) - 1L, ncol(feat_mat))
  pca_res <- rsvd(feat_mat, k = k)
  var_pct <- pca_res$d^2 / sum(pca_res$d^2) * 100
  pc_scores <- sweep(pca_res$u, 2, pca_res$d, `*`)

  cum_var5 <- sum(var_pct[seq_len(min(5, length(var_pct)))])
  append_sanity(
    paste0("pca_cumulative_variance_pc1_5_", stratum_key),
    "PASS", # informational, not a gate
    cum_var5, NA,
    sprintf("%s: PC1 var=%.1f%%, cumulative PC1-5=%.1f%%", stratum_key, var_pct[1], cum_var5)
  )

  # --- item 3: protocol should not dominate PC1 ------------------------------
  # protocol has exactly 2 levels (mRNA-Seq/total-RNA-Seq) -- operationalize
  # "PC1 loads protocol with |loading| > 0.5" as |cor(PC1 score, protocol)|,
  # since protocol itself isn't a PCA input feature (it's metadata used only
  # for coloring/grouping), a literal PCA loading doesn't exist for it.
  protocol_num <- as.integer(factor(sub_dt$protocol))
  protocol_cor_pc1 <- suppressWarnings(cor(pc_scores[, 1], protocol_num, use = "complete.obs"))
  protocol_dominates <- var_pct[1] > 50 & abs(protocol_cor_pc1) > 0.5
  append_sanity(
    paste0("pca_protocol_dominance_", stratum_key),
    ifelse(!protocol_dominates, "PASS", "WARN"),
    protocol_cor_pc1, 0.5,
    sprintf(
      "%s: PC1 var=%.1f%%, |cor(PC1, protocol)|=%.3f (flag if PC1>50%% var AND |cor|>0.5)",
      stratum_key, var_pct[1], abs(protocol_cor_pc1)
    )
  )

  # --- item 4: imputed vs observed samples should not separate ---------------
  imputed_any <- NULL
  if (has_imputed_info) {
    source_mat <- as.matrix(sub_dt[, ..source_cols])
    imputed_any <- as.integer(apply(source_mat == "imputed", 1, any, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (length(unique(imputed_any)) > 1) {
      imputed_cor_pc1 <- suppressWarnings(cor(pc_scores[, 1], imputed_any, use = "complete.obs"))
      imputed_dominates <- var_pct[1] > 50 & abs(imputed_cor_pc1) > 0.5
      append_sanity(
        paste0("pca_imputation_dominance_", stratum_key),
        ifelse(!imputed_dominates, "PASS", "WARN"),
        imputed_cor_pc1, 0.5,
        sprintf(
          "%s: PC1 var=%.1f%%, |cor(PC1, imputed_any)|=%.3f (flag if PC1>50%% var AND |cor|>0.5)",
          stratum_key, var_pct[1], abs(imputed_cor_pc1)
        )
      )
    } else {
      append_sanity(
        paste0("pca_imputation_dominance_", stratum_key),
        "PASS",
        NA, 0.5,
        sprintf("%s: all sampled rows have the same imputed/observed status, nothing to compare", stratum_key)
      )
    }
  }

  # --- item 5: silhouette by group, on a further subsample (dist() is O(n^2)) -
  sil_idx <- if (nrow(pc_scores) > SIL_SAMPLE_N) sample(nrow(pc_scores), SIL_SAMPLE_N) else seq_len(nrow(pc_scores))
  sil_pcs <- pc_scores[sil_idx, seq_len(min(10, ncol(pc_scores))), drop = FALSE]
  sil_dist <- dist(sil_pcs)

  mean_silhouette <- function(grouping) {
    grouping <- grouping[sil_idx]
    if (length(unique(grouping)) < 2) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    mean(cluster::silhouette(as.integer(factor(grouping)), sil_dist)[, "sil_width"])
  }

  sil_ontology <- mean_silhouette(sub_dt$ontology)
  sil_protocol <- mean_silhouette(sub_dt$protocol)
  sil_imputed  <- if (has_imputed_info) mean_silhouette(imputed_any) else NA_real_

  append_sanity(
    paste0("pca_silhouette_", stratum_key),
    "PASS", # informational -- reports which variable best explains PC separation, not a gate
    NA, NA,
    sprintf(
      "%s: mean silhouette (first 10 PCs, n=%d) -- ontology=%.3f, protocol=%.3f, imputed=%s",
      stratum_key, length(sil_idx), sil_ontology, sil_protocol,
      ifelse(is.na(sil_imputed), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", sil_imputed))
    )
  )

  # --- visualization: PC1/PC2 + UMAP colored by ontology/protocol/imputed ----
  umap_res <- uwot::umap(
    feat_mat,
    n_neighbors = UMAP_NEIGHBORS, min_dist = UMAP_MIN_DIST,
    metric = UMAP_METRIC, n_threads = 2L, seed = getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_SEED", 42L)
  )

  plot_df <- data.table(
    PC1 = pc_scores[, 1], PC2 = pc_scores[, 2],
    U1 = umap_res[, 1], U2 = umap_res[, 2],
    ontology = sub_dt$ontology, protocol = sub_dt$protocol,
    imputed = if (has_imputed_info) factor(imputed_any) else NA
  )

  legend_theme <- theme(legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
  make_panel <- function(x, y, color, xlab, ylab) {
    ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], color = .data[[color]])) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
      labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, color = color, title = color) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) + legend_theme
  }

  color_vars <- c("ontology", "protocol", if (has_imputed_info) "imputed")
  pca_panels <- lapply(color_vars, function(v) make_panel("PC1", "PC2", v, sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_pct[1]), sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_pct[2])))
  umap_panels <- lapply(color_vars, function(v) make_panel("U1", "U2", v, "UMAP1", "UMAP2"))

  fig <- (wrap_plots(pca_panels, nrow = 1) / wrap_plots(umap_panels, nrow = 1)) +
    plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s -- PCA (top) / UMAP (bottom)", stratum_key))
  print(fig) # inline, alongside the saved PDF below
  ggsave(
    file.path("qc/distributions", sprintf("feature_pca_%s.pdf", stratum_key)),
    plot = fig, width = 12, height = 9
  )

  invisible(NULL)
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata))) {
  run_stratum(strata$`Event Type`[i], strata$transcript_filter[i])
}
```


```{r, summary}
knitr::kable(fread(sanity_csv)[grepl("^pca_", check_name)])
```
